skill.name: background-remover
skill.description: Remove backgrounds from JPG, PNG, and WebP images by sending them to the verging.ai background removal API.
skill.summary: Creates transparent-background images through the verging.ai background removal service.
skill.author: verging.ai

security_audit.summary: The skill is a documented client for the verging.ai background removal service and intentionally performs authenticated network uploads of user images. Most markdown backtick findings are false positives, but the curl workflow, external API calls, API key handling, temporary files, and public result URLs are real security and privacy risks.

remediation.suggestion: Prefer environment variables or a secret manager, discourage command-line API keys, and never print Authorization headers in logs or examples.

remediation.issue: External image transfer and public result URLs
remediation.suggestion: Warn users before uploading sensitive images, document retention and access controls, and use expiring private result URLs where possible.
Validate URL schemes and hosts, quote all local paths, and restrict downloads to http or https resources requested by the user.
Use a unique per-run temporary directory with restrictive permissions and clean it up on success, failure, and cancellation.

content.value_statement: Manual cutouts take time and often look uneven. This skill sends images to verging.ai and returns transparent-background results.
actual_capabilities: Accepts local image paths and remote image URLs as input.
Supports JPG, JPEG, PNG, and WebP files up to 10MB.
Uses a verging.ai API key from an option or environment variable.
Checks account information and credits before processing.
Uploads images to a presigned storage URL for processing.
Polls job status and returns the processed result URL.
limitations: Requires a verging.ai API key and available credits.
Uploads source images to an external service for processing.
Needs network access and curl for the documented workflow.
Only documents common raster image formats, not vector files.

use_cases.title: Prepare Product Listings
use_cases.description: Remove distracting backgrounds from product photos before publishing catalog images or marketplace listings.

use_cases.title: Clean Profile Images
use_cases.description: Create headshots with transparent backgrounds for profile pages, decks, and brand materials.

use_cases.title: Build Design Assets
use_cases.description: Convert source images into transparent PNG assets for layouts, campaigns, and visual mockups.

prompt_templates.scenario: Process an image from a URL
prompt_templates.prompt: Remove the background from https://example.com/photo.jpg, show progress, and report the final image link.

prompt_templates.title: Specify Credentials and Output
prompt_templates.prompt: Use my configured VERGING_API_KEY to process ./hero.webp and save the result to ./out/hero-transparent.png.

output_examples.input: A seller provides a product photo with a busy tabletop background.
output_examples.output: The assistant reports the upload, processing status, and a link to a transparent-background product image.

output_examples.input: A designer asks to process a WebP image and save the result locally.
output_examples.output: The assistant completes the job, downloads the transparent image, and confirms the saved file path.

output_examples.input: A user submits a remote portrait image URL.
output_examples.output: The assistant downloads the source image, sends it for background removal, and returns the completed result URL.

best_practices: Use an environment variable or secret manager for the verging.ai API key.
Confirm that images are safe to upload before processing private or regulated content.
Keep source images under the documented size and format limits.
anti_patterns: Do not paste API keys into shared chats, tickets, or repository files.
Do not process confidential images without approval for external upload.
Do not assume public result URLs are private access controls.

faq.question: What does this skill do?
faq.answer: It removes image backgrounds by sending supported files to the verging.ai background removal API.

faq.question: Which image formats are supported?
faq.answer: The skill documents JPG, JPEG, PNG, and WebP support, with a maximum file size of 10MB.

faq.question: Does it need an API key?
faq.answer: Yes. It requires a verging.ai API key, usually provided through the VERGING_API_KEY environment variable.

faq.question: Are images processed locally?
faq.answer: No. The documented workflow uploads images to verging.ai storage and processing endpoints.

faq.question: Can it use remote image URLs?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill can download a remote image URL before uploading the image for processing.

faq.question: Can it save the finished image locally?
faq.answer: Yes. The documented options include downloading the result or saving it to a requested output path.
